title: RANK is BLANK where there is more than one current row, as at a total
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", RANK ( DENSE, ALL ( 'Product'[Product] ), ORDERBY ( 'Product'[Product], ASC ) ) )

source.quote: RANK returns a blank value for total rows.
source.supports: a total has several current rows

source.quote: when there is no current row – like at the total level – RANK shows a blank
source.supports: no single current row gives BLANK

derivation: No row context and no filter on the product: every product is a current row, with ranks 1 to 4, so there is no one current row and RANK is BLANK.
notes: The type of the number is not asserted: the column is BLANK.
